description: Source code for the PDCCH slot resource allocator in a 5G NR scheduler, implementing CCE allocation and DFS search for resource assignment.

classes.name: pdcch_slot_allocator
classes.description: Class responsible for allocating PDCCH resources using DFS search and CCE management.

methods.name: clear
methods.description: Clears internal records and DFS trees.

methods.name: alloc_pdcch
methods.description: Attempts to allocate a PDCCH for given context and configuration.

methods.name: cancel_last_pdcch
methods.description: Cancels the last allocated PDCCH and frees resources.

methods.name: alloc_dfs_node
methods.description: Allocates a DFS node for CCE position search.

methods.name: get_next_dfs
methods.description: Advances to the next DFS node in search.

methods.name: allocate_cce
methods.description: Allocates a CCE position if no collision occurs.
